description_zh: 在狭窄无标线的北向单车道上，Motional 车辆减速至 1.5mph 让对向来车通过，对向车经过时驾驶员侧后视镜与 Motional 车辆的后视镜及 LIDAR 外壳发生擦碰。
reason: 现有 oncoming block 仅有 speed 和 encroach 参数，无法表达极窄横向间距（side mirror contact）导致的侧擦。本场景需要设定两车对向行驶时 lateral ≈ 0.1，而 oncoming 不支持 lateral 参数，故无法准确建模。
proposed: 为 oncoming block 增加可选的 lateral 参数，用于指定会车时两车之间的横向距离；或新增一个 narrow_passage 原语，表示无分道线的狭窄双向道路上两车低速交会发生侧擦。

source_snippets: The Motional vehicle was traveling on 4th Ave, between Brooks Ct and Broadway St, in Venice, CA in manual mode in the sole northbound lane.
While navigating the narrow two-lane, unstriped road, the safety driver slowed the vehicle to 1.5mph to allow a driver coming in the opposite direction to navigate past the Motional vehicle.
The other vehicle’s driver side wing mirror made contact with the Motional vehicle’s driver side wing mirror and LIDAR casing, causing cosmetic damage.
